name: Shining City Pack
description: An irregular 5-day event with built-in pack purchases. A Shining City Pack gives a Lucky Glorious Tome Chest, which holds 5 to 100 Glorious Tomes to spend in the Exchange Shop.

phases.name: Daily rewards
phases.description: Claim 100 Gems free every day. After you buy a Shining City Pack that day you can also claim 80 Glorious Tomes.

phases.name: First daily packs
phases.description: The first purchase of each pack tier each day gives bonus rewards: Lucky Glorious Tome Chests, Gems, VIP XP, Custom Resource Chests, and an Alliance Gift. After that, the first two tiers can be bought up to 3 more times that day and the third tier up to 5 more times, at the normal reward.

phases.name: Exchange Shop
phases.description: Spend Glorious Tomes on items. Both the Glorious Tomes and the Lucky Glorious Tome Chests do not expire and can be saved for future Shining City events.

rewards.name: Glorious Tome
rewards.note: Event token, 5 to 100 from each Lucky Glorious Tome Chest. Item not linked.

rewards.name: Custom Classic Skin: City
rewards.note: Exchange Shop. If you own the available skins you can pick only Mythic General Hero Shards.

rewards.name: Custom Classic Skin: March
rewards.note: Exchange Shop. If you own the available skins you can pick only Mythic General Hero Shards.

rewards.name: Custom Classic Skin: Decoration (Island)
rewards.note: Exchange Shop. You can keep getting them after max level and recycle extra copies in the Recycle Shop.

tips: The wiki does not recommend any of the three limited Exchange Shop items.
Exchange Shop items differ with your state progress and the skins in the current rotation.
The chance of each Glorious Tome amount from a chest is shown only as an image.
